records.label: Exact-phrase request
records.expected_behavior: Request a complete phrase rather than separately segmented terms.
records.notes: The official advanced-search interface offers a complete-keyword field; the legacy help describes double quotes. No live exactness or query-rewriting behavior was tested.

records.label: Site restriction
records.expected_behavior: Request results limited to the specified domain.
records.notes: Legacy official help documents site: with no space after the colon and no URL scheme. This does not establish completeness of the result set.

records.label: PDF file-type restriction
records.query_template: "[目标公司全称]" 年度报告 filetype:pdf
records.expected_behavior: Request annual-report results in PDF format.
records.notes: The legacy official help lists DOC, XLS, PPT, PDF, RTF, and ALL. Reviewing that list does not establish current indexed coverage or live filter enforcement.

records.label: Modern Office file types
records.expected_behavior: If supported, request one selected modern Office format; support is not established by this record.
records.notes: Replace the entire bracketed file-type placeholder with exactly one extension. The legacy documentation reviewed does not list DOCX, XLSX, or PPTX; absence from that old list does not prove present-day failure. Test separately before relying on these templates.

records.label: Site restriction and coverage limit
records.expected_behavior: Request results from the specified domain; an indexed URL is not guaranteed to appear.
records.notes: Google explicitly cautions that site: results are not exhaustive. A zero-result query cannot establish that a record is absent.

records.label: PDF file-type restriction
records.query_template: "[目标公司全称]" 年度报告 filetype:pdf
records.expected_behavior: Request PDF results using Google's documented filetype: operator.
records.notes: The documentation lists indexable formats and filetype: usage. Indexable does not mean every file is indexed, readable, or returned for a particular query.

records.label: Title keyword
records.query_template: intitle:中标公告 "[目标公司全称]"
records.expected_behavior: Request the specified term in page-title metadata.
records.notes: Microsoft documents one term per intitle: keyword and allows repeated keyword entries. It cautions that features may vary by country or region; Chinese tokenization was not tested here.

records.label: Filename extension
records.expected_behavior: Request results with the specified filename extension.
records.notes: Microsoft distinguishes ext: (filename extension) from filetype: (file type). This record documents ext: only; no query was executed.

records.label: Registry access state
records.expected_behavior: A permitted manual visit may show the registry or an access requirement. Record the actual state before drawing conclusions about record availability.
